chat.label: Chat
chat.hint: Ask anything — general questions, explanations, calculations or how to use this app.

sql.label: SQL
sql.hint: Explain, debug or write read-only SQL. Apply generated SQL straight to the editor.

script.label: Analyze
script.hint: Generate or refine a Python/JavaScript script that processes the queried rows.

chart.label: Chart
chart.hint: Describe a chart (ECharts) to apply to the Analyze tab, or just ask anything. Refine it over several turns.

insight.label: Insights
insight.hint: Generate an AI insight card from the loaded grid — overview, key findings and next steps.

analyze.label: Deep Analysis
analyze.hint: Describe a goal and run a full analysis in one shot — narrative, charts and statistics — then keep asking follow-up questions on the same data.

empty.chat: Ask anything — e.g. “What does this app do?”, “Explain standard deviation”, or “Summarize this data in plain words”.
empty.sql: e.g. “Explain what this SQL does”, “Fix the error: …”, or “Write a query for …”.
empty.script: e.g. “Write a Python script that groups rows by region and prints the total amount per region.”
empty.chart: e.g. “A bar chart of total amount per region, title “Sales by region”, blue bars.” — or just ask, e.g. “What chart type fits this data?”
empty.insight: Run a query, then generate an AI insight card — an overview of the data, key findings and suggested next steps. Add an optional focus above to steer the analysis.
empty.analyze: Describe your analysis goal above (optional), then run the pipeline — a written analysis plus charts and statistics for the loaded grid. Follow-up questions keep the same data context.

insight.focusPlaceholder: e.g. focus on regional sales trends or data-quality issues…

analyze.noChartData: No chart could be built from this data.
analyze.goalPlaceholder: e.g. find the main drivers of regional sales and how they changed over time…
analyze.followupPlaceholder: e.g. why did one region drop last month? Follow-up questions keep the same data context.

placeholder.chart: Ask anything, or describe the chart you want…
placeholder.sqlScript: Ask anything or request SQL / a script…

notices.sqlApplied: SQL applied to the SQL editor.
notices.scriptInserted: Script inserted into the Analyze editor.
notices.chartAppliedScript: Chart applied to the Analyze tab.
notices.chartAppliedBi: Chart applied to the Dashboard chart builder.
notices.insightDownloaded: Insights downloaded as a Markdown file.
notices.reportExported: Report exported as an HTML file.
notices.analyzeDownloaded: Analysis downloaded as a Markdown file.

errors.scriptEmpty: The script is empty — nothing to apply.
errors.noOption: The script did not produce an ECharts `option` object.
errors.sqlEditorEmpty: The SQL editor is empty — write or load a query first.
errors.emptyResponse: The AI returned an empty response. Please try again.
errors.notConfigured: AI is not configured — set it up in the AI Setting tab.
errors.parseChartFailed: Failed to parse the chart script
errors.noGridData: No grid data to analyse — run a query first.
errors.copyFailed: Copy failed — the clipboard is not available.
errors.noQuestions: No follow-up questions were suggested this time. Try again.
